summary.zh: 一列任务从空心圆 → 转圈 → 弹出绿勾，进度条和计数同步走，全部完成后底部弹出「通过」。每条耗时不一样，看起来才像真的在跑。
summary.en: A checklist goes empty → spinning → pop-in green check, with a synced progress bar and counter; a pass banner springs up at the end. Each item takes a different time, so it reads as real work.

technique.zh: li 的 ::before 画状态圆（idle/run/ok 三种 class），::after 画勾；勾用带回弹的 cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) 从 scale(0) 弹出；进度条用 scaleX。
technique.en: li::before draws the status ring (idle/run/ok classes), ::after the tick; the tick pops from scale(0) with cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); the bar uses scaleX.

desc.zh: 每条大概跑多久（ms），实际会随机 0.6~1.5 倍

adapt.zh: 接真实任务时，去掉随机时序，在任务开始/结束时分别给 li 设 run / ok。
adapt.en: For real tasks, drop the random timing and set run / ok on each li as the task starts / ends.
